name: vis_male_transfer_function
purpose: Direct-volume-rendering transfer function (opacity/color control points) tuned for this raw dataset's intensity histogram. See examples/show_hist.py to inspect a dataset's histogram before tuning new points, and camera_reasoning/volume_scene.py build_volume_rendering_pipeline() for how these are consumed.
notes: Background/soft-tissue peak sits around 60-80; bone density climbs from ~90 up through the low 200s. Originally tuned in examples/render_skull_transfer_function.py.
